payload.comment:
Reporting stage is internally consistent and complete. All cross-artifact arithmetic verified: (1) abstain_rate 0.385794 + test_coverage 0.614206 = 1.0; (2) human_review_count 2770 = 7180 × 0.385794; (3) selective_risk 0.031293 = 1 − accuracy_on_covered 0.968707; (4) risk-coverage curve entry at target 0.8 matches top-level threshold/coverage/risk exactly; (5) accuracy_delta 0.044707 = 0.872841 − 0.828134; (6) common_seed 72 and split_fingerprint 9afc9ed3…c7505 are identical across baseline, agentic, and comparison reports; (7) search selection used validation-only metrics (test_metrics_used: false) with 8/8 trials completed and no missing families. No deterministic findings are present.

Warnings (non-blocking, methodological observations):
1. Validation–test coverage gap: 80% target validation coverage yields only 61.4% test coverage, and validation risk (0.00075) is ~40× lower than test risk (0.0313). Selective-prediction guarantees are materially weaker on the test split; deployment planning should anchor on test-side figures.
2. OOD evaluation is restricted to additive Gaussian noise (σ ∈ {0.15, 0.25, 0.4}) as a corruption proxy. ood_pass (AUROC 0.936) should be interpreted as a narrow robustness check, not a full distribution-shift guarantee covering staining variation, scanner artifacts, or rare morphologies.
3. 38.6% abstention (2 770 samples) is a significant human-review burden; the risk-coverage curve shows diminishing returns above 70% target coverage, making the 80% target defensible but operationally costly.
4. Class 7 (cancer-associated stroma) test recall is 0.489 (CI95 0.442–0.537) with 97 misclassifications to debris and 57 to smooth muscle; class 0→5 confusion (306/1338, 22.9%) drives class-5 precision to 0.567. A single global threshold (0.8725) does not account for per-class difficulty.
5. Inert transformer-specific config fields (num_heads, patch_size, pooling, positional_encoding, tokenizer_layers, mlp_ratio) persist in the resnet18 train_config and baseline tiny_cnn config; functionally harmless but create schema ambiguity for downstream tooling.
6. early_stopping_patience=3 is below the commonly recommended 8–12; did not trigger in this run but could cause premature stopping under a different seed.
7. class_weighting is disabled despite 1.63× class imbalance; minority-class recall (class 7: 0.489) suggests under-served classes.

None of the above constitute deterministic correctness errors. The reporting artifacts are well-formed, complete, and arithmetically consistent. The pipeline may proceed.
